doc.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018

title: Touring with Postmodern Jukebox
summary: He is on and off tour with the vintage-style band; Branford Marsalis likes it.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: You’re going on tour with them?
Yeah, an on and off tour, yeah. Speaking of trad bands.
Yeah. What’s their thing, new music, old style.
Yeah. That’s a good niche these days, it seems to be a good niche.

That’s their niche and people really respond to it. I saw Branford and I was talking to him and we have a mutual friend, Chris Hemingway, who I was on the road with with Postmodern Jukebox. And I said, “Hey I just got off the road with Chris Hemingway.” He goes, “Oh Postmodern Jukebox, I love that band.” I didn’t expect for him to say that you know.
